# PDF case study generator

Builds `docs/FIGHTEX_Architecture_Case_Study_EN.pdf` — a 7-page A4 engineering case study with diagrams and charts.

**All figures use illustrative synthetic data.** The CSV files in `data/` are invented and generated by
`generate_synthetic_data.py` with a fixed seed. They are not FIGHTEX audit results, customer parameters or output of the
private simulation engine. The script does not import private code, connect to any service or run a simulation of the real
engine; the determinism table on the last page comes from a tiny toy model defined in `build_case_study.py`.

## Run

```bash
cd tools/pdf-demo
python3 -m venv .venv && source .venv/bin/activate     # Python 3.10+
pip install -r requirements.txt
python generate_synthetic_data.py                       # optional: rewrites data/*.csv (identical output)
python build_case_study.py                              # writes ../../docs/FIGHTEX_Architecture_Case_Study_EN.pdf
```

## Files

| File | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `generate_synthetic_data.py` | Seeded generator of the synthetic CSV data |
| `data/*.csv` | Synthetic inputs of the charts (marketplace, liquidation, bot-farm lenses, multi-account groups, finance, sensitivity, seed spread) |
| `build_case_study.py` | Renders the charts (matplotlib) and lays out the report (ReportLab) |
| `requirements.txt` | NumPy, matplotlib, ReportLab |

The report text and diagrams describe architecture only; the charts show the shape of the analyses, not real values.
